techniques.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/windows/approval/priceCheck.test.tsx:25 The name overstates what is pinned: Rust is never reached and no shared vector exists (searched crates/ and bindings/ for the cases).

apps/desktop/client/src/windows/approval/review/market.render.test.tsx:33 Before relying on the shared mock world, the test asserts that the seeded deal actually carries the invariant the HOLD case needs (seeded-data honesty).

apps/desktop/client/src/windows/approval/listingCode.test.ts:68 The claim is a user-felt window freeze, not overlap or cutoff. The bound is loose and one-sided (1 s against 8 s measured unfixed), which is the technique's own exemption.
